title: Location filter is the rightmost toolbar control, a multi-select with an All Locations option
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the report as a user with access to two or more locations.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the toolbar controls left to right.
2. Open the location filter and read its options.
custom_expected:
1. The location filter is the rightmost control in the toolbar.
2. It is a multi-select listing the locations the user has access to, plus an "All Locations" option.
